<!-- pr-reviewer: 72eeb3e976be9bdbcc5dcaebbe1ba8e7679e5c77 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The fallback uses the current bore counts from commit `2407d9b09` and keeps the previous band widths. The three new tests check the center, both limits for each count, the counts next to those limits, and earlier mesh readings. This meets the unit-test acceptance criterion in #3085. The platform pins and safety assertions stay in place.

I ran these checks locally on macOS arm64. The PR head already contained upstream main at `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`.

- Quick gate, `app suites: pocket3d_hsm` — 5 passed, 2 ignored. All three new tests and the macOS exact-pin test passed.
- Focused test build and strict Clippy for `pocket3d_hsm` — passed.
- Light gate — release build passed. Motion lib had 7 passes. Motion `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, and `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start` each had 1 pass.
- Diff whitespace check — passed.

### Extra suites run

None required. The diff changes one test file and one decision record. No heavy bore run or fourth-platform measurement was part of this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
